in_marathi.name: Geetpriya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Song of Love
in_marathi.long_meaning: Geetpriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Geetpriya is a beautiful Sanskrit name that is derived from the words 'geet' meaning song and 'priya' meaning beloved or dear. This name signifies the love and devotion that is expressed through song. In Hindu mythology, songs and chants are used to invoke the gods and goddesses and to connect with the divine. This name is a reminder of the power of love and music to bring happiness and joy to our lives.
